bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$root"
git fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111
rev=3e6667ba84b0cd2326838d81afad1a5344697a1e
git cat-file -e "$rev^{commit}"
test -f deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session || exit 81
test "$(stat -c %a deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session)" = 600 || exit 82
test -x deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python || exit 83
test -f scripts/userbot_session.py || exit 84
if test -e scripts/userbot_keepalive.py; then
 test "$(sha256sum scripts/userbot_keepalive.py | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(git show "$rev:scripts/userbot_keepalive.py" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 85
else
 git show "$rev:scripts/userbot_keepalive.py" > scripts/userbot_keepalive.py
 chmod 600 scripts/userbot_keepalive.py
fi
python3 -B -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open("scripts/userbot_keepalive.py").read())'
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"
unit="$HOME/.config/systemd/user/gace-userbot-verify.service"
if test -e "$unit"; then
 test "$(sha256sum "$unit" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(git show "$rev:deploy/systemd/gace-userbot-verify.service" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 86
else
 git show "$rev:deploy/systemd/gace-userbot-verify.service" > "$unit"
 chmod 600 "$unit"
fi
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 8
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 87
journalctl --user -u gace-userbot-verify.service --since '2 minutes ago' --no-pager -o cat | grep -q USERBOT_SESSION_CONNECTED || exit 88
echo USERBOT_KEEPALIVE_RUNNING=YES
echo USERBOT_UNIT_ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)
echo USER_LINGER=$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)
echo LOGIN_CODE_REQUESTED=NO
